hypotheses.statement: The CSV writer library introduced in release 2.1.0 may have failed silently without changing exit status
The job may have encountered empty or malformed input data on 2026-01-15, causing the CSV writer to produce no output
A filesystem or permission issue may have prevented writing output while allowing the job to exit successfully

observed_facts.statement: The reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 reported exit status 0 (success)
No output file was produced for the 2026-01-15 reconciliation run
Files for all other January dates are present in the shared location
No monitoring alerts were configured for the reconciliation job
Application logs are retained for seven days only
Upstream input data is retained for seven days only
Release 2.1.0 replaced the CSV writer library approximately nine hours before the failed run
The scheduler reports success based on exit status alone and does not verify output production

open_questions.question: Did the reconciliation job actually process any rows on 2026-01-15, or did it encounter empty input?

summary: The reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 reported success (exit status 0) but produced no output file. The failure went undetected for eight days due to lack of monitoring. A library update deployed nine hours before the run may have introduced silent failure behavior. Critical evidence (logs and input data) was lost due to seven-day retention policies.

timeline.statement: Release 2.1.0 deployed, replacing the CSV writer library
Reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 reported successful completion with exit status 0
No monitoring alerts fired for the reconciliation job
Reconciliation job for 2026-01-22 completed successfully, processing 412093 rows and writing output
Finance reported missing reconciliation output for 2026-01-15; files for all other January dates present
Scheduler showed 2026-01-15 reconciliation run as completed successfully with exit status 0
Application logs for 2026-01-15 run were not retained due to seven-day retention policy
No monitoring alerts were configured for the reconciliation job
Upstream input data for 2026-01-15 cannot be replayed due to seven-day retention
2026-01-15 output was regenerated manually from a downstream copy; root cause remains unknown
